clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Old Town, the Command Center trains recruits while most of the army serves abroad. Also called the Stormwind Barracks, it houses the city's military officers and a seasoned skeleton crew focused on drilling recruits and local militia.

In Old Town, Stormwind's Command Center is a garrison and training ground for the kingdom's soldiers. Its halls are quieter than usual, with much of the royal army committed to campaigns abroad. Veteran instructors, including Ander Germaine and martial artist Wu Shen, train fresh warriors to strengthen the city's defenses.

When you ask for instruction in heavy arms or tactical combat, Stormwind's guards may point you to the Barracks. The building sits near the Pig and Whistle Tavern and the shadowy operations elsewhere in Old Town. It helps keep order in a district known for tavern brawls and roguish activity.
